trailhead.label: Klammeben, top station of the Hirzer cable car, the board’s start

cautions: Cattle graze the alpine pastures in summer: keep your dog on a short lead, give cows a wide berth and let go of the lead if cattle charge.
At about 2,000–2,130 m the weather turns fast: check the forecast and turn back in a storm.
Busy with walkers on the E5 in summer: keep your dog close.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
